sentences.text: This is a wholly misconceived petition filed by a group of 35 persons impleaded as the petitioners herein to seek benefits of the provisions of Section 30(3) of the Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013 on the premise that the statutory benefits of Section 30(3) were not accorded to them on the compensation determined by application of multiplication factor-2.

entities.text: Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: NEUTRAL CITATION C/SCA/12877/2025 ORDER DATED: 06/10/2025 undefined 2.
Pertinent is to note that there is no description in the writ petition about the land owned by each of the petitioners herein.
In paragraphs - 4.3 of the writ petition, certain survey numbers have been given without even mentioning the village or the persons to whom the same belong.
Moreover, there is no clarity about the Factor-1 and 2 award passed in case of each of the petitioners herein.
3. In absence of these details in the writ petition, the prayers made in the writ petition cannot be appreciated.
Such petition seeking benefits of Section 30(3) of the Act, 2013 cannot be entertained.

4. At this stage, Mr. Vedant Rajguru, learned advocate holding brief of Mr. A.J. Yagnik, learned counsel appearing for the petitioners would submit that the petitioners be permitted to withdraw the present petition with liberty to file writ petitions for their individual rights and grievances in a better manner.
5. In view of the above statement, the present petition is NEUTRAL CITATION C/SCA/12877/2025 ORDER DATED: 06/10/2025 undefined dismissed, as withdrawn with a liberty as prayed for.
(SUNITA AGARWAL, CJ ) (D.N.RAY,J) A. B. VAGHELA Harising Vajesing Dabhi vs Competent Authority And Special Land ...
